label: POSSIBLE_FACT_2, actual obtaining…: Possible concrete facts/events/states of affairs are distinct…
term: possible fact, actual obtaining, involved being/property and necessary being/system in Koons1996 Corollary1
definition: Possible concrete facts/events/states of affairs are distinct from propositions. Actuality is a possible fact obtaining. Corollary1 presumes every fact includes some being and a property of it, assumes actual involvement requires the being’s actual existence, and infers necessary existence of some being or system from a necessary fact.
note: Editorial source glossary, not a new formal framework. Fixed fact domain differs from fixed bearer constitution and all-world realization. Source T connects necessity and actual obtaining; the existing Arena consumer instead explicitly retains both actual and boxed truth without assuming reflexivity. No arbitrary K assignment proves real involvement, and no cause-fact is identified with an ordinary causing individual or classical God.
